source.source_type: web appendix / supplementary material to a systematic review and network meta-analysis
source.supplement_title: Comparative effectiveness of non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs and opioid therapy for the treatment of pain in knee and hip osteoarthritis: a network meta-analysis
source.parent_article_title: Effectiveness and safety of non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs and opioid treatment for knee and hip osteoarthritis: network meta-analysis

source_integrity_findings.detail: Web-appendix 7 page 31 reports 139 participants; Web-appendix 8 page 34 reports 0 randomized participants.
The protocol sentence describing binary outcomes prints “odds ratio (RR)”; the analysis tables and completed article use odds ratios.

extraction_scope.included: Protocol/review methods, every non-missing primary Web-appendix 7 treatment-effect cell, dose-response signals with p<0.05, model-fit and consistency diagnostics, funding/conflict statements, and source-integrity discrepancy.
extraction_scope.not_atomized: Bibliographic reference lists and the 61-review screening list; individual trial-characteristic rows in Web-appendix 11; every cell of repetitive sensitivity tables 14-16. These remain reconciled in the SEA coverage section.
extraction_scope.secondary_source_guardrail: Atoms describe review-level methods and review-reported network estimates. They do not imply that the review itself enrolled participants or that cited primary trials were directly read.

external_boundary: The parent BMJ article was accessed externally only to identify its exact metadata and extract the requested reference queue. ATOM extraction is grounded in the retrieved Drive supplement.
